methodology_note: Every candidate below is a live TradingView Pine INPUT override applied to the exact frozen, unmodified pine/XAUUSD_Adaptive_Master.pine (SHA-256 6c4dbba9105db1f75a07682408a8d91f34929d594cf8ddf7eaaea0defa57d3b6, never edited during P7). No candidate was omitted, including losing ones. All candidates measured on 15m unless noted; the selected candidate was additionally measured on 5m and 30m. bars figures reflect the loaded buffer at capture time (~5179-5183 for 15m).

one_factor_sensitivity_15m.note: identical to baseline -- no BO signal in this window had a late-entry bar count between 7 and 10

combination_search_15m.notes: Strongest single-timeframe (15m) result; not cross-timeframe tested because N1/C4 (below) explored the same neighborhood with better sample retention.

Combining two independently-positive stricter filters did NOT compound positively: cumulative R fell BELOW baseline (13.0 vs 19.67) and max fail streak worsened (8 vs 5) despite a 37% sample reduction. Retained in the ledger as a disclosed negative result, not hidden.

Best isolated 15m result among neighborhood checks, but its 5m cross-timeframe result was -2.74 cumulative R (a sign flip from the +0.26 P6 baseline) -- see cross_timeframe_selected_candidate below. Superseded by C4, which removes the qualityThreshold=60 component responsible for the 5m regression.
Confirms the C3/N1 neighborhood is robust, not an isolated spike -- neighboring quality values (60, 62, 65-implicit-in-C1) all land in a similar 25-29 cumulative-R band.

Only the two most independently-robust single factors (minRR, corrResolveConfirmBars) changed; qualityThreshold left at the frozen baseline (65) specifically because every quality-loosened variant (C3, N1) degraded 5m -- see cross_timeframe_selected_candidate.

cross_timeframe_selected_candidate.cross_timeframe_verdict: 15m improves substantially; 5m and 30m are statistically flat (cumulative R unchanged to two decimal places on 5m, exactly unchanged on 30m) -- no timeframe got WORSE, but only one timeframe (15m) genuinely improved. This is reported as a real, disclosed, timeframe-concentrated improvement, not a broad-based one.

reproducibility_check.method: Removed the live-tested indicator instance entirely (0 studies confirmed), added a completely fresh instance from the unmodified saved cloud script, then applied the exact C4 input overrides to the new instance.
reproducibility_check.result: IDENTICAL: 60 signals / 22 PASS / 37 FAIL / 1 OPEN / cumulative R 27.63 / mean R 0.47 on 15m -- byte-for-byte the same as the in-place indicator-set result.
reproducibility_check.operational_finding: indicator-set input changes on an existing instance DO trigger a full var-state recompute, but the recompute can take substantially longer (empirically up to ~15-20s on this ~5100-8400 bar history) than initially assumed; reading the stats table too early (e.g. after only 2s) returns a stale, partially-recomputed, non-reproducible value. All P7 readings in this ledger were taken only after two consecutive reads (5-6s apart) returned identical values.
